title: Todd’s
html_source:
I’m pretty sure this is a reference to St Columba’s College, a co-educational boarding and day school founded in 1843 located in Whitechurch, Dublin, Ireland. James Henthorn Todd was one of the founders.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Can you find a source for this?
